question_text: A 15-year-old girl is recruited by a neighbor to work as a domestic helper in another city. The neighbor promises her family a monthly salary of ₱5,000, but upon arrival, the girl is forced to work without pay and is not allowed to leave the house. Which provision of RA 7610 (Special Protection of Children Against Abuse, Exploitation and Discrimination Act) is primarily violated?

options.text: The prohibition against child labor, which sets the minimum age for employment at 18.
The prohibition against child trafficking, which includes recruitment for forced labor and debt bondage.
The prohibition against child abuse, which only covers physical harm.
The prohibition against child prostitution, which involves sexual exploitation.
